# lab-dns

Knot, answering for the lab's zone from the host and from inside the network.

<!-- Generated by nix/floe-docs.nix. Refresh: nix run .#refresh-docs -->

## Inputs

| input | type | default | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| configureHost | boolean | `false` | Point this machine's resolver at the lab during `cata lab up`, so `*.<zone>` resolves in a browser and in anything run by hand.  Off by default because it needs `sudo` and edits configuration outside the lab, which is a poor default for a command whose job is to be reversible. The steps that do it and undo it exist only when this is on.  |
| image | string | `"cznic/knot:latest"` | Knot DNS container image. |
| tsigKeyname | string | `"externaldns-key"` | TSIG key name for RFC2136 dynamic updates. |
| tsigSecret | string | `"kp4bgnFAVCmajGIqOW7rj0MNwRNZHBqMvYaLTwzPHgI="` | Base64 TSIG secret.  A fixed default, and deliberately so: this authorises updates to a throwaway zone served on loopback, and generating one per lab would put a value in the store that every lab then has to be told. A lab that exposes its DNS beyond the host should set its own.  |
| tsigSecretAlg | string | `"hmac-sha256"` | TSIG algorithm. |

## Requires

| hole | signature | what it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| network | [LAB_NETWORK](../signatures/LAB_NETWORK.md) | The docker network a lab's containers share, and the gateway address on it. |
| zone | [DNS_ZONE](../signatures/DNS_ZONE.md) | The lab's DNS zone and the server authoritative for it. The only fully portable signature. |

## Provides

| provision | signature | what it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| resolver | [HOST_RESOLVER](../signatures/HOST_RESOLVER.md) | A resolver on the lab's network, as another container on it reaches it. |
| service | [HOST_SERVICE](../signatures/HOST_SERVICE.md) | A container the lab runs on the host, as `setup-services` starts it. |
| step | [LAB_STEPS](../signatures/LAB_STEPS.md) | Plan steps a floe contributes, keyed by step name. |

## Emits

| alias | kind | what it carries |
| --- | --- | --- |
| dnsInfo | catallaxy.dnsInfo | Where the lab's resolver answers, as `cata lab dns` configures the host. |

## What it emits

Rendered by `gitops.local` as the lab unit `dns`. A unit of the lab
installs nothing into a cluster, and its provisions are sealed inside the
lab's inclusion — so its declaration above is its interface.

## Output kinds

| kind | entries |
| --- | --- |
| catallaxy.dnsInfo | host, port, tsigKeyname, tsigSecret, tsigSecretAlg, zone |
